id: title:dmarchuk:record batch audience fetch duration by endpoint and outcome

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a Histogram and Counter for audience-fetch duration and outcome, and encapsulates shared fetch/response parsing, supporting SLO tracking and maintenance of HogFlow batch-person-query service.
review.reason: The change replaces duplicated inline fetch and error-handling with a dedicated private async method and adds a Histogram and Counter. This is a substantive, bounded improvement: it removes duplication and introduces a dedicated, labeled, and bucketed metric for audience-fetch latency, which could support alerting, SLO tracking, or capacity planning for the HogFlow batch-personary.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of an alerting or SLO system that consumes these metrics; the code does not independently establish that such a system exists or that the metric will be used. No tier assignment was requested, so no score is returned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive refactoring of audience-fetch behavior. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, so no score is returned.

observations.behavior: Adds a Histogram and its associated Counter, and a new private async method, while removing duplicated inline fetch and error-handling code. The Histogram records wall-clock duration and outcome labels; the Counter records timeout and error outcomes. The new method encapsulates the shared fetch and response parsing, and the callers are simplified to delegate to it.
observations.posthog_connection: This change could help PostHog by providing a dedicated, labeled, and bucketed metric for audience-fetch latency, which could support alerting, SLO tracking, or capacity planning for the HogFlow batch-person-query service.
